reason: The cited lines define get_project as a read-only tool whose execute handler returns await e.getProject(id), described as getting details for a Supabase project. That supports SECRET because it returns project details from a Supabase account context, i.e. SaaS data associated with the user's account. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show agent-supplied data being sent to an attacker-chosen or attacker-readable destination; passing an id to an account API method is not enough to establish a SINK. Whether the returned project details contain attacker-controllable content is not settled by these lines alone.
